vocabulario.texto: An imaginary situation is different from the present.
An unlikely condition can use if plus past.
Could gives a possible result, not a real plan.
A real plan has a confirmed time or arrangement.

texto.es: La voz pasiva se usa cuando importa más lo que se hace que quién lo hace. En presente se forma con am/is/are + participio pasado: Bread is made every morning (el pan se hace cada mañana). titulo.es: Seguir las etapas: was received, is being repaired

texto.es: Cuando algo pasa por varias etapas (se recibe, se revisa, se repara, se confirma), cada etapa se cuenta con la pasiva adecuada. Lo terminado va en pasado: The bicycle was received on Monday. Lo que ocurre ahora va con is/are being + participio: It is being repaired now (la están reparando). Lo que falta se dice con will be + participio (It will be returned on Friday) o con has not been + participio (It has not been confirmed yet). Cada fecha va con su etapa: no las mezcles.

titulo.es: Preguntar por el estado de algo y pedir una acción

texto.es: Para resolver un problema de estado (un pedido o una reparación que no llega), primero cuenta lo que ya pasó en pasado pasivo (was received, was checked). Luego di lo que ocurre ahora con is being + participio y nombra la etapa que falta con has not been + participio. Termina con una petición concreta: Please confirm when it will be delivered. Dentro de la petición el orden es normal (when it will be…), no de pregunta. Usa solo los datos que tienes, sin inventar fechas.

I recommend Busy Neighbours to this family audience. The 94-minute comedy follows two neighbours organising a fair, and reviewers praise its amusing dialogue. It is suitable for ages ten and over and has no frightening content. However, its ending is predictable. Moon Door lasts only 88 minutes, but scary scenes and a twelve-plus rating break two limits. Thirty-two cars wait with engines running outside the school, which worsens local air. Parents prioritise cleaner air; however, drivers need a place for brief waits. The agreed measure is a signed no-idling zone costing no more than £300. The school will install it by 15 May. If the zone is signed and its signs are made visible, engine idling may fall without promising a complete end. Staff will compare idling-car counts across four mornings before and after installation. This comparison will test the measure against the documented baseline. The final record names the cause, effect, viewpoints, responsible school, deadline and practical follow-up measure.
The cardboard cage will be installed by the thirtieth of April.

The market records 40 cardboard boxes reaching the street each Saturday because shops leave them beside bins. Shop owners need convenient collection, while residents want cleaner streets. The group agrees on a £450 cardboard cage, managed by the traders association and installed by 30 April. If the cage is installed and emptied regularly, street waste may fall. The association will count loose boxes for eight Saturdays and compare them with the current baseline. This negotiated record keeps both priorities visible and confirms a viable action, responsible actor, deadline, limited effect and measurable indicator.

items.respuesta: Thirty-two cars wait with engines running outside the school, which worsens local air. Parents prioritise cleaner air; however, drivers need a place for brief waits. The agreed measure is a signed no-idling zone costing no more than £300. The school will install it by 15 May. If the zone is signed and its signs are made visible, engine idling may fall without promising a complete end. Staff will compare idling-car counts across four mornings before and after installation. This comparison will test the measure against the documented baseline. The final record names the cause, effect, viewpoints, responsible school, deadline and practical follow-up measure.
aceptadas: Thirty-two cars wait with engines running outside the school, which worsens local air. Parents prioritise cleaner air; however, drivers need a place for brief waits. The agreed measure is a signed no-idling zone costing no more than £300. The school will install it by 15 May. If the zone is signed and its signs are made visible, engine idling may fall without promising a complete end. Staff will compare idling-car counts across four mornings before and after installation. This comparison will test the measure against the documented baseline. The final record names the cause, effect, viewpoints, responsible school, deadline and practical follow-up measure.

The school meeting identifies idling engines as the cause of poorer air and records 32 waiting cars. Parents want cleaner air, while drivers need a short waiting option. The school agrees to create and sign a no-idling zone by 15 May within the £300 budget. If the zone is signed and clearly marked, idling may decrease. The result remains limited. The school is responsible, and staff will count idling cars for four mornings before and four mornings after the change. These counts provide a clear baseline and follow-up comparison. The comparison will show whether the local measure is working. This agreement recognises both positions and records a viable action, condition, limited effect, deadline and measurable indicator.
items.texto: Reunión escolar: causa: motores encendidos; efecto: aire peor y 32 coches en espera. Padres quieren aire limpio; conductores necesitan espera breve; escuela dispone £300. Acuerdo: zona sin ralentí y cartel, responsable: escuela, plazo: 15 mayo. Si se señaliza, puede bajar el ralentí. Indicador: contar coches cuatro mañanas antes/después.
